title: Software Engineer - L2 L3 forwarding, C / C++, IOS XR  8 to 10 years
description:

Join Cisco’s Service Provider Networking team, where software and forwarding hardware work together to move traffic across some of the world’s largest networks. The team builds high-performance IOS XR forwarding capabilities, giving you the opportunity to solve real networking challenges and contribute to technology used by service providers globally. As a Senior Software engineer, you will lead the technical delivery of complex forwarding features, guide design and implementation choices, and drive issues across software, platform, and hardware boundaries. You will also contribute to engineering practices and mentor teammates.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own design and implementation of complex IOS XR L2/L3 forwarding features from requirements through integration and release.
* Develop and optimize production C/C++ software for packet processing and data plane functions.
* Lead feature work in areas such as EVPN, VPLS, MPLS, Segment Routing, SRv6, QoS, ACLs, mirroring, OAM, tunnels, and slow path processing.
* Translate protocol and product requirements into scalable software designs and effective test strategies.
* Investigate complex system and customer issues using logs, traces, packet captures, core files, and hardware diagnostics; drive root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Analyze and improve forwarding performance, including throughput, latency, scale, and resource utilization against platform targets.
* Coordinate with IOS XR, protocol, hardware/NPU, architecture, validation, and customer support teams to resolve integration and deployment issues.
* Review designs and code, raise software quality, and mentor engineers in implementation, debugging, and testing practices.
* Use approved AI tools in daily engineering workflows for code analysis, implementation support, test development, debugging, and documentation; validate outputs for correctness, security, and suitability.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Suggested 8+ years of relevant software development experience and a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong C/C++ skills and a record of developing and delivering complex production software.
* Strong knowledge of networking, L2/L3 forwarding, and service provider technologies.
* Experience with Linux/UNIX systems, embedded software debugging, testing, and performance analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to lead feature design, resolve cross-component issues, and collaborate across teams.
* Regular use of AI tools for engineering tasks, with sound judgment and responsibility for validating results.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Cisco IOS XR or a comparable carrier-grade network operating system.
* Deep experience with one or more of EVPN, VPLS, MPLS, Segment Routing, SRv6, QoS, ACLs, BFD, GRE, or related technologies.
* Experience with NPU/ASIC data planes, hardware SDKs, packet-processing pipelines, or hardware/software integration.
* Strong background in performance optimization, system-level debugging, and customer issue resolution.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving design, testing, or development workflows.

Success means delivering complex forwarding capabilities that meet functional, scale, and performance goals; leading issues to root cause and resolution; and improving the team’s technical quality through design guidance, collaboration, and mentorship.

title: Development Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

* App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.
* Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Application Development**

* Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
* Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
* Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
* Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.

**Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards**

* Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
* Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
* Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.

**Secure Development & Technology Risk**

* Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
* Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
* Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
* Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

**API, Integration & Data Engineering**

* Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.
* Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.
* Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.
* Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.

**DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness**

* Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.
* Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.
* Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability.
* Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.

**Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability**

* Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.
* Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.
* Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.

**Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.
* Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.
* Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.
* Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment**

* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.
* Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.
* Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.

**Skills And Experience**

* Software Engineering
* Programming Principles
* Application Programming Interface
* Database Development
* Distributed Systems
* DevOps
* Software Testing
* Secure Coding
* Web Application Security
* Mobile Security

**Other Skills**

* Platform Management
* Operating Systems
* Computer Network
* Database Administration
* Functional Writing

* Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity.
* Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions.
* Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued.

**Qualifications**

* Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes.
* Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions.
* Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.
* Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement.

**Meet The Team**
Team: Mass-Scale Infrastructure Group (MIG) – Platform Forwarding
  
  
You will join the MIG Platform Forwarding team, the engine room behind the world’s most robust service provider networks. We build the high-performance data plane software that powers IOS-XR platforms, using innovative Silicon One (SiOne) Network Processing Units (NPUs).
  
  
Our team operates at the intersection of hardware and software, defining how packets traverse the internet's backbone. We are transitioning into a new era of embedded development, using modern AI-assisted methodologies to deliver features faster and with higher quality.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Software Engineer, you will focus on the hands-on design, coding, and optimization of our forwarding software. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality code for complex L2 /L3 forwarding featurfeatures,uring they extract maximum performance from our NPUs. You will act as a key technical contributor, using modern software practices and AI-driven workflows to streamline development and debugging.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Feature Design & Implementation**
: Be responsible for the design and development of specific forwarding features within the IOS-XR platform. Write high-performance, production-grade code for QOS, Mirroring, Slowpath, OAM, Layer 2 (EVPN, VPLS) and Layer 3 (SRv6, Segment Routing, MPLS) technologies.
  
  
**NPU Data Plane Programming:**
Implement data plane logic to optimize packet processing. Translate network protocol requirements into efficient NPU microcode and SDK interactions.
  
  
**Debugging & Root Cause Analysis:**
Investigate and resolve complex software defects found during internal testing or customer deployments. Analyze logs, core dumps, and packet traces to distinguish between NPU behavior and software logic issues.
  
  
**Performance Optimization:**
Profile and tune code to minimize latency and enhance throughput, ensuring the software meets strict service provider performance metrics.
  
  
**Modern Development Practices:**
Actively use AI/LLM-based tools for code generation, unit test creation, and static analysis to improve individual efficiency and code quality.
  
  
**Requirements**
Embedded Development: Strong proficiency in C/C++ for high-performance embedded systems. Proficiency in Python for scripting and test automation.
  
  
NPU Familiarity:NPU-based data plane architectures (e.g., Broadcom DNX, Silicon One, or ezChip). Understanding of pipelining, table management, and packet processing flows.
  
  
Forwarding Protocols (L2/L3): Strong understanding and implementation experience in Qos, Mirroring, OAM , Layer 2 (EVPN, VPLS) or Layer 3 routing (SRv6, Segment Routing, MPLS, IPv4/v6). Implementation experience with TE-Tunnels, GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, ACLs, or Slowpath forwarding mechanisms.
  
  
**Network Knowledge & Debugging**
Service Provider Context: Understanding of router deployments in Service Provider networks (Core, Peering).
  
  
Technical Troubleshooting: Ability to debug issues at the component level, including hardware/software interactions and memory management.
  
  
Modern SDLC: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and code review processes. Willingness to adopt AI/LLM-based tools to enhance coding efficiency and automated testing.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* 4 - 8 years of experience in embedded software development for networking products.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++ and scripting in Python
* Solid knowledge of carrier-grade networking OS and forwarding architectures.
* Experience debugging complex embedded software issues.
* Experience working on tools such as Clearcase, Valgrind, DDTS, GDB, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with \\*\\*IOS-XR\\*\\* or similar carrier-grade network operating systems.
* Knowledge of Internet Protocols (TCP/UDP, IPv4/IPv6).
* Exposure to Networking Protocols (L2/L3, QoS, ACLs,).
* Experience with BCM, Sione,, Ezchip NPU programming
* Familiarity with AI/ML tools for software engineering (e.g., Copilot for code, AI for log analysis).

**Job Description**

**Overview**

We are looking for a skilled and experienced
**Java Full Stack Lead**
to join our development team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in object-oriented programming, strong experience with the Spring Framework, and practical frontend experience with React JS.

This role requires a collaborative mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and an interest in developing high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance, reusable Java applications.
* Develop and maintain responsive frontend components using React JS, JavaScript, and related technologies.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries for relational databases such as DB2 or Oracle.
* Work with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ.
* Develop scalable solutions using microservices architecture to ensure modularity, availability, and ease of deployment in distributed systems.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs to enable backend-to-frontend integration
* Analyse requirements and propose effective technical solutions considering functional and non-functional requirements.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
* Write automated unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito.
* Write and maintain documentation of software components and code.
* Conduct and participate in peer code reviews and design discussions.
* Ensure performance, security, and availability of applications.
* Identify and address technical risks and issues; propose and implement practical solutions.
* Conduct demos and facilitate acceptance discussions with Product Owners to validate deliverables.
* Maintain a proactive attitude toward learning and adopting new tools and frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Required experience and skills**

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on delivery of backend or distributed systems; the technical lead should typically have 10+ years.

Strong Java experience (Java 17 or later preferred) and production experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, service design, testing, and troubleshooting.

Experience designing distributed systems and event-driven architectures, including Kafka or a compatible platform such as Amazon MSK.

Experience deploying or operating containerised services on Kubernetes; AWS EKS experience is strongly preferred.

Sound understanding of relational databases and SQL, data modelling, transactions, concurrency, schema evolution, and performance tuning.

Experience with at least one document database and one Redis-compatible in-memory data platform; understanding of when to use each and their consistency and failure trade-offs.

Practical knowledge of API and event versioning, idempotency, resiliency patterns, back-pressure, timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.

Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, source control, code review, and production support for business-critical services.

Clear communication skills and the ability to explain design trade-offs and work effectively across teams.

**Preferred experience**

Experience in payments, fintech, commerce, banking, provider integrations, or another regulated, business-critical domain.

Familiarity with payment lifecycle concepts, provider routing, payment status handling, reconciliation, refunds or reversals, and operational exception flows.

Experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, Secrets Manager, KMS, IAM, CloudWatch, and managed messaging or networking services.

Experience with Datadog and OpenTelemetry, including distributed tracing and service-level indicators.

Infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation; Helm and GitOps-based Kubernetes delivery.

Awareness of PCI DSS and secure handling of sensitive payment data. Direct compliance implementation experience is an advantage, not a substitute for sound engineering fundamentals.

**Technology environment**

Core engineering environment:
  
Java and Spring Boot; AWS EKS; Amazon MSK; Amazon DocumentDB with MongoDB compatibility; Amazon MemoryDB for Redis; Amazon RDS; Amazon S3; AWS Secrets Manager; and Datadog. The final service choices and versions will be confirmed during solution design.

Candidates should be able to reason from workload needs and operating requirements rather than assume a particular service is right for every use case.

**Recommended stack additions and design clarifications**

API edge and protection:
  
identify whether Kong or Amazon API Gateway will own external API management, and include AWS WAF where public web APIs require managed edge protection.

Async work and recovery:
  
use MSK for domain event streams where replay and multiple consumers matter; consider SQS with dead-letter queues for isolated work queues and controlled redelivery. Define outbox/inbox and idempotency patterns across database and message boundaries.

Security and audit:
  
include AWS KMS, IAM roles for service accounts, CloudTrail, network segmentation, and a clear sensitive-data and tokenisation approach. Confirm applicable PCI DSS scope and market-specific obligations with the client security team.

Platform delivery:
  
include infrastructure as code, Helm, CI/CD or GitOps, automated security checks, environment promotion, and tested rollback procedures.

Telemetry:
  
standardise on OpenTelemetry-compatible instrumentation and consistent correlation IDs; use Datadog as the operational view, with CloudWatch retained where needed for AWS-native signals.

Database fit:
  
confirm DocumentDB API and feature compatibility against the application’s MongoDB driver and required behaviors before locking the choice. Use MemoryDB when Redis-compatible in-memory data durability is required; if the primary need is an expendable low-latency cache, evaluate ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey. Specify the RDS engine and its purpose.

Workflow orchestration:
  
keep latency-sensitive payment processing paths lean. Consider a workflow engine for long-running or human-assisted exception flows only when the state, timeout, and recovery requirements justify it.
